basics.label: Student
basics.summary: I am a student at the University of Hawaii at Manoa, pursuing a B.S. in Computer Engineering, with an expected graduation in May 2027.

highlights: Developed automated data analysis and reporting tools using Excel VBA and Power Query, including a custom macro that parsed 1,000+ pages of PDF/Word documents to extract and format tabular data into editable spreadsheets
Performed comparative analysis across technical documents to identify and resolve discrepancies with contractors, ensuring version control and accuracy
Designed and implemented an AI-based tool to convert handwritten notes and meeting minutes into structured, searchable summaries for internal use
Developed a working local Retrieval Augmented Generation model using Gemma 2B via LangChain
Achieved efficient data processing to handle large amounts of data at once
Continuously improved model to achieve 70-80% accuracy
Enhanced communication skills with staff members, parents, and kids
Built strong teamwork essentials, through collaborating with other volunteers and staff
Gained experience in conflict resolution and maintained a positive demeaner to ensure a safe and supportive environment
